headline: West Chester make eight goals go a long way
dek: West Chester have scored eight goals all season, more than only Lock Haven, and conceded seven. Sunday's win over Shepherd was their third of the season against two draws and three defeats, and none of their wins has seen them concede.
displaced_by: The standing Gannon figures (six wins, twenty-four scored, nine conceded) are not true of today's data, which carries Gannon at two wins, fourteen scored and two conceded; West Chester's win over Shepherd on 2026-09-27 won the slot

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Millersville have scored more than Lock Haven, Pitt-Johnstown and West Chester together, and seven different players have scored for them: the spread of scorers, not one name, is what the chart is drawing.

wire.line: Three players account for every goal West Chester have scored, and they have still won as often as they have lost.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's home match against District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: E. Stroudsburg lead the table without a conference defeat, and all three of their losses came before conference play opened; across the season they have won six, drawn two and lost three.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pitt-Johnstown have conceded 26 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, and have won one match, drawn one and lost five.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rafael Santos has four goals and seven assists from 25 shots for Seton Hill.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jaden Howard has made 36 saves for West Chester and been beaten five times.

last_match.line: Shepherd had not lost since Millersville visited on the opening day of conference play; West Chester have yet to concede in a match they have won.

next_match.line: Gannon have yet to lose a conference match and have yet to play one away; California (Pa.) have won every conference match they have played.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
